transfer.interpretation: Trial acceptance bounds, not estimates of source accuracy. Every bilinear contributor must be within 20 m of the closest RMOC source point; the same point must be visible in the full RMOC mesh.

limitations: One grayscale observation retaining photographed illumination; not true color or recovered albedo.
This historical trial omits detector-quality gating. The application integration separately qualifies the matching L4 quality companion.
GEO geometry uses SHAP7; the retained mesh uses RMOC MTP019. Their agreement is measured, not assumed identical.
The archive errata accept only cg-dlr_spg-shap7-v1.0_4Mfacets.ver.
Gray grid means no accepted photograph sample; it does not classify the underlying RMOC shape as unmeasured.
